notes: User dimensions describe independent rectangular plates, not a replacement of the saved main CAD roof.

Plate is inserted inside the chamber. Each triangular post sits under its side edge, with a flat vertical face touching the upright wooden wall. Screw axis points outward and downward at 45 degrees, from the top pocket into that wall.

Post size, head pocket, hole positions, bore clearance and joint clearance are trial design values. The supplied 45 degree orientation and 7.6 mm head diameter are confirmed; head height and underside shape are not.
Nominal wood engagement assumes the reported screw length is measured below its head; no washer or gasket allowance is included.
The lap and perimeter require continuous sealing; a dry lap or screw head is not an airtight seal.
No spindle holes or floating-deck support recesses are inferred from the main assembly.
